name: chip
description: A filter you turn on and off. Selected is a filled chip, not a different widget.
avoidWhen: Do not use for actions; use button. Do not use for exclusive peer panes; use segmented-control or tabs.

ux.behaviour: Selected is a filled chip; unselected is an outline
ux.why: You can scan which filters are on

ux.behaviour: Tapping toggles and fires a tick haptic
ux.why: A filter should feel flipped, not pressed like a button

ux.behaviour: The chip is 48 dp tall and scales while pressed

aiHints: Own selected in the caller; this is a toggle, not a radio unless you make it one
Do not put an onClick that navigates; chips filter the current screen
